items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What do you think about the -- the school of bass players that's come up in the later period, maybe beginning with someone like Scott LaFaro... [INTERVIEWEE] 'Cello?

ctx.x: But when Charlie Parker started with and Diz their's, you'd have to sit at the front of your seat to listen, which doesn't mean that you're relaxed. You're just a listener then.
